explanation: I searched Mathlib for IsValuativeTopology, ValuativeRel.ofValuation and of_mem_nhds_zero_iff_vle. The closest match is the instance `IsValuativeTopology (WithVal v)` in Topology/Algebra/Valued/WithVal.lean. It is stated for the type synonym `WithVal v`. It is not stated for an arbitrary `[Valued R Γ₀]` with the topology coming from `hv.toUniformSpace`, so it cannot be applied to this theorem's setting without more work. `IsValuativeTopology.of_mem_nhds_zero_iff_vle` is the constructor the proof already uses, and the Padics file has a similar instance for ℚ_[p] only. I found no general `Valued` version in Mathlib.
